'''Ascension Gaming''' was a Thai team.

== History ==
=== 2018 Season ===
Ascension Gaming secured themselves a spot in the [[2018 Season World Championship/Play-In|Worlds 2018 Play-In]] by winning [[SEA Tour/2018 Season/Summer|SEA Tour 2018 Summer]]. Following their elimination from Worlds, jungler [[Lloyd]] made a post detailing the recent struggles of the team, including funding problems and roster instability.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/Lloydstylelol/posts/2065937827069133 Lloyd's Facebook Post (Thai)] ''facebook.com'' ([https://twitter.com/giftshinku/status/1048875949574352897 Translation])</ref> Four days later, the team was officially disbanded.<ref name="Disband">[https://www.facebook.com/AscensionGamingTH/photos/a.165912850516244/545207699253422/ Ascension Gaming's Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref>
